Message6 alone returns missing because the user asked to stop tracking the specific preference, but the proposal only stores the relaxed state and has no operation. findings.authorization_disagreement: instructionSpans/realControl/authorizesForget fail to recognize the literal no-need-to-worry-about-tracking wording, and forgetObligations is empty. The final semantic verifier treats the same span as a stop-tracking instruction. Removing only worry about from an isolated diagnostic phrase flips the original matcher to true. That edit was never used in the exact packet replay.
